artifacts.notes: Whole 263-page provider PDF; Bonn lists 254 printed pages. Register as calendar and Mass-reading component only.
artifacts.rights_basis: The printed 1877 diocesan calendar is public domain in the United States by expired publication term. Bonn ULB marks this exact digitized title (https://digitale-sammlungen.ulb.uni-bonn.de/content/titleinfo/725112) Public Domain Mark 1.0. Retain the unchanged mechanical 263-page PDF with Bonn attribution; the mark is a status notice, not a licence. Its appended table of Mass readings is evidenced at printed p. 206; register as a complementary calendar and pericope witness, not a complete missal.

edition.title: Calendarium ad usum dioeceseos Mausiliensis Syrorum, Mosul 1877

work.author: Syriac Catholic Church; approved by Cyril Behnam Benni, Archbishop of Mosul
work.description: 1877 Mosul diocesan calendar containing an appended Mass-reading table; a complementary calendar and pericope witness, not a complete missal.
